Bump RDF testsuite
CI: use OIDC for codecov and codspeed

spareval: move out expression evaluator and expose errors when building the expression evaluator

- error converting terms from the storage
- unknown custom function
- arity error for custom function
CI: codspeed: Use simulation instead of instrumentation mode
